name: RC-B10-0497/2026 – § 19 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text: 19. Reaffirms its full support for the ICC’s investigation in Ukraine, as well as in all situations under its jurisdiction, and its overall efforts to prosecute individual responsible for genocide, war crimes, crimes against humanity and the crime of aggression; condemns the US sanctions against the ICC, its prosecutors, judges and staff; calls on the Commission to activate the Blocking Statute to protect the ICC from extraterritorial sanctions;
